comment: Read from src/PolygeneModule.cpp, src/PolygeneWidget.cpp, src/OrbitsModule.cpp and manual/docs/index.md at commit 71660d9, the commit that raised the version to 2.0.4. The manual is wrong about all four value CV jacks: it says each voltage is divided by 5 and multiplied by the matching knob setting, but src/PolygeneModule.cpp:113 to 138 divide by 5 and ADD the result to the channel's stored setting, scaling by 31 for length and shift and by the pattern count for variation. There is no CV gain knob on this module at all, which is the likely source of the confusion, since Eugene has three. All of the value jacks are stepped in effect rather than continuous: clampRounded at src/PolygeneModule.cpp:35 adds a half and truncates, so the total lands on a whole beat, hit or pattern. The reverse and invert CV jacks read getPolyVoltage at src/PolygeneModule.cpp:82 and 95, so a monophonic cable there reaches every channel and they are not listed under Mono Input Behavior. The clock input's channel count alone decides how many rhythms run and how many channels the outputs carry, at src/PolygeneModule.cpp:394 to 396. The plugin-wide Theme menu item is cosmetic and carries no line.
